computer-science-bs.name: Major Electives
computer-science-bs.note: The catalog requires 9 credits of CS electives above CS 300, at least two above CS 332. Three common options are seeded so the generator can produce a concrete draft; students must verify elective choices with an advisor.

computer-science-bs.name: General Education
computer-science-bs.note: General Education categories are listed in the catalog but are not fully expanded in this seed.

computer-science-bs.name: Free Electives
computer-science-bs.note: Elective totals depend on choices that need advisor verification.

information-technology-bs.name: Major Electives
information-technology-bs.note: The catalog lists IT elective choices, but this seed does not schedule them by default.

retrievalNotes: The official JMU 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog PDF is bundled as the current offline catalog source.
Program requirements refresh from the current path-based catalog.jmu.edu program and course pages.
AP transfer rules retain their 2025-2026 source labels until that chart is independently re-verified against the current edition.
Programs without parsed requirement rows are included as catalog shells and are flagged unverified in the app.
